component.name: Endpaper
component.summary: Read and study your EPUB books

description.p: Endpaper is a friendly bookshelf and a quiet place to read. Your books stay plain EPUB files in a folder of your choice, with one subfolder for each category — no database, no account, no network access.

ul.li: A shelf with categories that fold away, and pinned books that stay in reach
Keep books in order right from the shelf: move them by dragging, rename them, add new ones
The table of contents beside the text, and the way back after following a link
Your choice of font, text size, line spacing, text width, hyphenation and colors
Pages or continuous scrolling, and every book remembers where you were
Mark passages without dragging: choose a color, click the first and the last word
Notes in Markdown beside the text, saved as a readable file next to the book
Bookmarks, answer fields of study editions, and previews of footnotes
Search in the open book and across the whole library, with other forms of a word
Reading progress as a ring, and finished books gathered at the end of the shelf

description.p: Endpaper works completely offline, collects no data, and never changes your books. Books protected by DRM are not supported.

description.p: Finished books, and marking made smoother.

ul.li: Mark a book as finished from the shelf, or when the book asks near its end; finished books also stand together at the end of the shelf
A mark over marks that are there already becomes one with them, and keeps all their notes
Changing the color while marking keeps the first word
Previews of footnotes and references show on hover while marking too
